Resolution File Format Cost per file
Tick One file per ticker per trading day per data format. Trade, quote, and open interest data are separate files. 150 QCC = $1.50 USD
Second One file per ticker per trading day per data format. Trade, quote, and open interest data are separate files. 100 QCC = $1 USD
Minute One file per ticker per trading day per data format. Trade, quote, and open interest data are separate files. 50 QCC = $0.50 USD
Hour One file per ticker per data format. Trade, quote, and open interest data are separate files. 1,500 QCC = $15 USD
Daily One file per ticker per data format. Trade, quote, and open interest data are separate files. 1,500 QCC = $15 USD
